storylines:
**OLD PATHS. NEW CHAPTER.**

Tuesday night sees two familiar North-West London sides cross paths once again as Hilltop make the trip to Tithe Farm. Rayners Lane’s history stretches back to 1933, while Hilltop are a much younger club, formed in 2005 and rising rapidly through the non-league pyramid. Despite the difference in age, the two clubs have shared plenty of the same road in recent years, including a fiercely competitive 2021/22 campaign when both were chasing promotion from Combined Counties Division One and scored a combined 228 league goals.

Their most recent league meetings came during the 2023/24 season, and both belonged to The Lane. Rayners Lane won 2–1 at Tithe Farm before following it with an impressive 3–1 victory in the return fixture, completing the league double over Hilltop. Much has changed since then, however, and with new squads, new ambitions and another season taking shape, previous results will count for little when the whistle blows. Hilltop arrive looking to rewrite the recent history between the sides. The Lane will be looking to make sure the story stays exactly the same.
